name: sqlite
makefile_append:
# sqlite3.c/shell.c are generated, and LAVA instruments the generated copies.
# sqlite's own rules would regenerate them (clean removes .target_source), so
# once they exist their recipes become no-ops.
ifneq ($(wildcard sqlite3.c),)
sqlite3.c: ; @:
endif
ifneq ($(wildcard shell.c),)
shell.c: ; @:
endif

.PHONY: lava_sqlite3
shell.lo:	shell.c
	$(LTCOMPILE) $(READLINE_FLAGS) $(SHELL_OPT) -c shell.c

sqlite3.lo:	sqlite3.c
	$(LTCOMPILE) $(TEMP_STORE) $(SHELL_OPT) -c sqlite3.c

lava_sqlite3:	shell.lo sqlite3.lo
	$(LTLINK) -o sqlite3 shell.lo sqlite3.lo $(LIBREADLINE) $(TLIBS)
